skins.name: Solo Around The World
skins.code: Test Birthday Collection 1101/Solo Around The World
skins.description: The Ark cradling the cocoon of dreams sailed into the galaxy, dissolving into millions of threads. With love as their needle, the many hands crafted a one-of-a-kind garment for Amiya. The remaining threads, intertwined with wishes, were fashioned into a violin.
